title: Detecting Harmful Short Videos in Toxic Diet Culture: A Governance-Ready Evidence Framework with Sparse Autoencoders
abstract: arXiv:2611.31354v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Algorithmic content moderation is increasingly important for governing short-form video content, yet harmful-content detection research focuses primarily on prediction or limited explanations. This leaves a governance challenge underexplored: producing decision-linked evidence that supports the review and justification of moderation decisions. Using toxic diet culture as an empirical case, we conceptualize governance-ready evidence as computational traceability, evidence localization, policy grounding, and evidence inspectability. We develop the Sparse Autoencoder-based Policy-Aligned Contrastive Evidence (SPACE) framework in a pretrained SAE feature space derived from a large multimodal model. A global relevance gate and decomposable linear evidence head identify decision-linked evidence; segment supervision and within-video ranking localize this evidence; policy alignment maps it to platform guidelines; and Pareto-efficient selection y

translated_title: 检测有毒饮食文化中的有害短视频：基于稀疏自编码器的可治理证据框架
translated_abstract: 算法内容审核对于短视频内容的治理日益重要，然而现有的有害内容检测研究主要聚焦于预测或有限的解释，这使得一个治理层面的挑战未被充分探索：如何生成与决策相关联的证据，以支持审核决策的审查与论证。本文以“有毒饮食文化”作为实证案例，将“可治理就绪的证据”概念化为四个维度：计算可追溯性、证据定位、政策依据以及证据可检验性。作者在由大型多模态模型导出的预训练稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征空间中，开发了基于稀疏自编码器的政策对齐对比证据框架（SPACE）：全局相关性门控与可分解的线性证据头用于识别与决策相关联的证据；片段监督与视频内排序机制对证据进行定位；政策对齐将证据映射至平台准则；帕累托高效选择……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出SPACE框架，利用大型多模态模型的稀疏自编码器特征空间，识别、定位并将证据对齐到平台政策，为有毒饮食文化等有害短视频的审核治理提供与决策关联且可检验的证据支持。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the SPACE framework, which leverages a pretrained sparse-autoencoder feature space from a large multimodal model to identify, localize, and align decision-linked evidence with platform policies, providing governance-ready evidence for moderating harmful short videos such as toxic diet culture.
